description: This is a classic, ornate chandelier, presented as a 3D model in a monochromatic white or very light grey. The fixture features a central decorative body from which multiple gracefully curved arms extend outwards. Each arm terminates in a candle-style light fixture, complete with a small circular bobeche (drip pan) below the 'candle'. The design appears to have multiple tiers of arms, suggesting a fixture with eight or more lights in total, arranged symmetrically around the central column. It is suspended from a ceiling cup by a chain link. The overall appearance is highly decorative and sculptural, evoking a sense of traditional elegance and grandeur.
